items.source: Creates a new RedactOperation that can restrict the content of a document based on information stored within the document itself.
items.translation: 创建一个新的RedactOperation，该操作可以根据文档内部存储的信息来限制文档的内容。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
